options.detail: Enter a positive byte count. Larger buffers can reduce round trips and use more memory. The fallback is 32768 bytes. When supported, the server supplies separate read and write limits.

when_absent.meaning: Without server limits negotiation the fallback is 32768 bytes. With limits@openssh.com and no explicit buffer, use separate server read/write lengths capped below the protocol packet limit and at least 64 bytes; SFTP v0 additionally caps buffers at 20480 bytes.
